body.name: Stationary compatible response-SCM class
body.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{d,k,T}(\epsilon,B)=\{(P,q,\rho,b,\pi,o,r,g,h): q\in\Theta(P),\ F_{1:T}\text{ satisfies the iid-response and initial-exogeneity conditions},\ Z_0=X_0,\ P\text{ satisfies positive-cells},\ r-g\mathbf 1=h-K_{\pi}h,\ \operatorname{span}(h)\le B\}\).
